title: 2141 - losing orders being edited
body:
The issue of losing form contents has returned, #2141 

The initial part of the problem was that `row.reference` no longer contained the message reference, it was a composite field containing reference and turn.

But, after fixing that is was still broken.

So, I started on a strategy of not updating the <PlanningMessagesList> if a message was being edited, and stored the updates for when the message was saved, or the row collapsed.

issues.title: New solution for "persistent forms"
issues.body:
For the wargame last week we had the problem where inline JSON-editors (in the Planning Messages component) got wiped when a new message was received.  This was captured in #2116

There wasn't a quick/easy fix for this, since the whole list component got replaced on refresh (via `data` prop).

The workaround was to push the document to be edited into the `NewMessage` component, which wasn't a child of the list.

Users still complained of `flicker` in the form, as it got wiped & reset.

We didn't implement the above workaround for the `Adjudication Messages List`.

So, the first part of this task is to see if we can make a JSON Editor component that is a `detail` element of a `Material-Table` persistent - so it isn't affected by new messages coming into the table.

_Maybe_ we can retain the `detail` component in some `useMemo` or `useRef`, and only update the editor if that specific document id is being edited (which it shouldn't ever be).

If we can't make the `detail` component persistent, we'll have to switch back to editing existing messages with the `NewMessage` component.  If we do that, we should investigate preventing the flicker that happens when new messages are received in that channel.

Note: we've adopted `material-table`.  But, the original developers are no longer maintaining it.  _Another_ table component may handle this update issue better. _Maybe_ this RSuite data table may be better for us:
https://github.com/rsuite/rsuite-table
